negative_prompt: watermark, text signature, logo in corner, artist name, copyright notice, blurry, low resolution, bad anatomy, smooth CGI plastic, modern factory machines, hyperrealistic human pores, cartoon illustration, bright neon lighting, digital distortion
reconstruction_priority: Loom warp threads and wooden machinery — AI typically collapses fine thread arrays into blurry solid planes or chaotic messy wire webs
Puppet face and flat cap craft — AI tends to hallucinate either generic cartoon characters or overly photorealistic human skin instead of textured clay and tweed
Tactile yarn and wool textures — AI often fails to render distinct fiber qualities between raw wool roving, spun yarn, and woven fabric
Hand grip on wooden beater — AI frequently generates mangled fingers or detached floating hands rather than articulated clay fingers gripping the wood
